# Go codegen for $"..." translatable strings: per-locale i18n.Translate wiring.

sngl compile --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# i18n runtime package is imported (no alias needed; last path segment is "i18n").
grep '"git.duckfam.us/jonathan/sngl/pkg/go/i18n"' out/model.go

# Static string $"Login" compiles to i18n.Translate(locale, key, inlined, args)
# with key == inlinedTemplate and locale resolved from the active locale context.
grep 'i18n.Translate\(i18n.DefaultLocale\(\), "Login", "Login",' out/model.go

# Empty args map is emitted for static strings with no placeholders.
grep 'map\[string\]any{}' out/model.go

# Translatable string with placeholder: args map contains the placeholder binding.
grep '"Hello, \{user\}!"' out/model.go
grep '"user":' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var greeting = $"Login"
    var user = "alice"
    var hello = $"Hello, {user}!"
    text(value=greeting)
    text(value=hello)
}
